title: A linear projection finite on a proper affine closed subset, avoiding infinity
statement: Let $k$ be an infinite field, let $m\geq1$, and let $Y\subsetneq\mathbf A^m_k$ be a proper reduced closed subscheme [def-sbc-affine-space, def-weil-closed-immersion]. There is a one-dimensional linear subspace $l\subset k^m$ such that the quotient projection $q:\mathbf A^m_k\to\mathbf A^m_k/l\simeq\mathbf A^{m-1}_k$ restricts to a finite morphism on $Y$ [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism]. After choosing a linear complement to $l$, identify $\mathbf A^m_k$ with $\mathbf A^1_k\times\mathbf A^{m-1}_k$ over the quotient. The scheme-theoretic closure of $Y$ in $\mathbf P^1_k\times\mathbf A^{m-1}_k$ is disjoint from the infinity section $\{\infty\}\times\mathbf A^{m-1}_k$.
